label: Aiming
depicts: Crosshair target ring with four outer ticks and one centered dot
use_when: Use when the interface wants a crosshair style target with one center dot and four outer ticks.
avoid_when: Do not use for the bullseye target when inner rings matter more than a single center dot.

label: Aiming
depicts: Bullseye target with two concentric ring circles and four outer ticks around a centered dot
use_when: Use when the interface wants a bullseye target with two inner rings inside the crosshair frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the single dot crosshair when the center should read as a filled dot instead of a ring.

label: Airpods
depicts: Two separate earbud stem shapes facing inward across the center
use_when: Use when the interface wants two loose earbuds rather than a case or charger shape.
avoid_when: Do not use for the charging case icon when the main shape should be a rounded box.

label: Airpods
depicts: Rounded charging case with a lid line and one centered latch
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rounded earbud charging case with a clear lid seam.
avoid_when: Do not use for the loose earbuds icon when no outer case should be visible.

label: Alarm
depicts: Twin bell alarm clock with two feet and short hands inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic twin bell alarm clock with feet at the bottom.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler round alarm when the floating bells and feet are not present.
